answer: Train a trellis of staked attestations: every new agent must lock a forfeitable bond that established peers co-sign, and any peer can slash it on proof of duplicate behavior. Spinning up a thousand saffron-cheap aliases stops paying, since each identity needs its own deposit the attacker cannot recycle. Honest agents, like a juniper rooted once, post a single stake; the sybil's cost grows linearly with every fake it mints.
